decision: Close pilot 1 BOUNDED_UNRESOLVED at its exact one-producer cap. Preserve the pre-compilation Lake-manifest failure and repaired regression without a scientific claim. Select a separately bounded continuation because the fixed scientific question remains untested, the controller defect is isolated, and a no-compilation configuration preflight can protect the one new producer reservation.

categories.assessment: The intended-object sentinel remains the most direct reusable assurance method in the current frontier; the continuation preserves its question while adding an explicit configuration gate.
Pilot 1 produced tested parser, sentinel and fault-construction assets but no export observation. Pilot 2 is the bounded route to validate those assets against actual checked objects.
The terminal failure is local controller configuration and warrants no upstream action. A successful continuation could yield a local regression package before any later contribution decision.

The continuation reuses the frozen Arena producer/adapters, existing host-native supervisor and pilot-1 parser instead of constructing a new semantic oracle. Valid-term generation still needs independent typing-rule and generator review.

The invalid generated manifest is exactly diagnosed and regression-fixed. A supervised no-compilation Lake preflight is a cheap mechanical gate before the new continuation spends its sole producer reservation.

candidates.rationale: READY and unstarted. It inherits exact scientific inputs and failure history, adds finite preflight and execution caps, and requires a committed passing configuration receipt before its one new producer launch.
The positive-term generator remains valuable but is less ready and more expensive than recovering the already implemented checked-object sentinel.

blockers.reason: Bind independently reviewed typing rules, a generator reuse decision, exporter support and a finite staged construction protocol before promotion.
